svg.desc: Akeanti. Electrical and energy engineering student at EHTP, first year, after CPGE MP. Power systems, embedded hardware and scientific computing. Open to a first-year internship, summer 2027, for 1 to 2 months. Now building: malfoid, last push 14 Oct 2026. Latest release: ariadne v3.0.0, 13 Oct 2026.
